description: §14.8.9 S441 round 4 (F3) — SQLite identifiers are case-insensitive: `SELECT PASSWORDHASH` selects the protected `passwordHash` column. Origin matching is case-folded, so extracting it (`v.PASSWORDHASH`) is E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED before the fix: the exact-case origin match missed PASSWORDHASH, no tag was emitted and the route served the hash (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar, S441 round 4 review).
